hard_gates: Environment setup writes local configuration only; it cannot create provider resources, credentials, domains, environments, deployments, or production state.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.

Edge deployment requires exact immutable code, bindings, routes, limits, traffic scope, health criteria, and rollback target; wildcard route or binding changes and unrelated resource mutations are blocked.
Kubernetes deployment is bound to one cluster, namespace, manifest set, image digest, identity, rollout, health gate, and rollback revision; readiness failure or unexpected diff blocks apply.
Readiness authority is read-only: no apply, patch, rollout, scale, restart, secret read, policy change, or namespace mutation is permitted.

Web deployment requires one exact provider project, environment, immutable artifact, configuration, domain and traffic scope, health gate, and rollback target; preview or identity drift blocks deployment.
inputs: Application, providers, environments, secrets policy, target, and deployment constraints.

Cluster and workload configuration, provider controls, expected traffic, failure budget, and deployment plan.
Build artifact, provider project, environment, secrets boundary, deployment plan, and authorization.

responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 5 related modes: Prepare local deployment configuration, provider choice, environment boundaries, secret references, and dry-run instructions without provisioning or deploying.; Deploy one immutable edge-worker artifact through one approved provider adapter after build, binding, route, limit, and rollback preflight.; Deploy one immutable application version to an existing Kubernetes platform with validated manifests, identity, rollout, health, and rollback controls under per-action authorization.; Read-only assess Kubernetes workload, cluster, identity, policy, scaling, networking, migration, health, and rollback readiness before deployment.; Deploy one immutable Web application artifact through one selected hosting provider adapter with exact environment, configuration, health, domain, and rollback controls.
